## 7.6 Extra Service Assignments

- Unless otherwise set forth, Extra Service Assignments shall be remunerated based on the product of the assigned factor times Class II, Step 5 of the salary schedule. All remuneration which is based on a percentage of a salary schedule will be rounded off to the nearest dollar; except for the Hourly Rate Factors of 7.6.8. All Extra-Service Assignments included in Article VII, sec. 6 shall be increased effective on December 1, 2015, in accordance to Article VII language. regular step
